intro: Palau has about 18,000 people, one of the smallest populations of any country.

chapters.title: People
text: Most people are Palauan; there are also Filipino workers. Palauan and English are official, and Japanese is official on Angaur. Families trace descent through mothers.

chapters.title: Ngerulmud
text: The capital, Ngerulmud, is one of the world's smallest; most people live in Koror.
